# FigCraft Guide

> An independent guide, known-issue tracker summary, and customizable browser canvas studio for FigCraft, an open-source Figma alternative written in pure Rust.

## Pages

- [FigCraft Guide](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/): what FigCraft is, a FigCraft vs Figma comparison, known issues from the GitHub tracker, install steps, a no-signup canvas studio, and an FAQ covering `.fig` import, fonts and multiplayer.
- [Known issues](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/#issues): large `.fig` imports, missing font fallback, macOS 27/M1 launch crash, Windows DX12 blur, 1440p UI scale, web file access and CLI path roots, with links to the source issues.
- [Install](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/#get-started): build the desktop app from source with Cargo and `craft-fonts`.
- [Studio](https://figcraft.rerivo.com/#demo): a browser canvas with size presets, custom width/height, background, transparency, grid, zoom, layers, properties, undo/redo and PNG/JSON export.

## Source project

- [storytold/figcraft](https://github.com/storytold/figcraft): the open-source project this page is about.
- License: MIT OR Apache-2.0. Status: early alpha, about 49% parity by the project's own estimate.
